description: This Java class 'MessageFactory' is responsible for creating 'MessageV1' objects used in external event messaging within the Fineract project. It handles message construction, formatting timestamps, and integrating external event data.

classes.name: MessageFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating MessageV1 objects from various inputs, including external event views and message components. It formats timestamps and manages message metadata.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Constructs a MessageV1 object from individual message components such as ID, source, type, category, timestamps, schema, and data.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a MessageV1 object from an ExternalEventView, extracting relevant fields and converting data.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the current tenant identifier from thread-local context.

methods.name: getMessageCreatedAt
methods.description: Formats OffsetDateTime to a string using a custom ISO local date-time formatter.

methods.name: getMessageBusinessDate
methods.description: Formats LocalDate to ISO local date string.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the bean, logging the message source UUID.
